onFirstInteraction.label: Customer's first conversation
onFirstInteraction.description: The customer talks to the agent for the first time.

onStartInteraction.label: Conversation start
onStartInteraction.description: A conversation starts (including from customers who have talked before).

onNewMessage.label: New message
onNewMessage.description: Every message from the customer or the agent.

onTransfer.label: Transfer to a human
onTransfer.description: The agent hands the conversation over to a team member.

onLackKnowLedge.label: Agent has no answer
onLackKnowLedge.description: The agent could not answer a question.

onCancelEvent.label: Appointment canceled
onCancelEvent.description: An appointment booked by the agent was canceled.

UPSERT_DEAL.label: Create or update deal
UPSERT_DEAL.description: Updates the conversation's deal or creates one in the chosen pipeline.

TIMELINE_COMMENT.label: Timeline comment
TIMELINE_COMMENT.description: Comment on the conversation's deal, lead, contact or company.

START_BIZPROC.label: Start business process
START_BIZPROC.description: Runs a business process on the conversation's entity.

OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK.label: Call external URL
OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK.description: Sends the event to another system (signed POST).

CREATE_SPA_ITEM.label: Create SPA item
CREATE_SPA_ITEM.description: New item in a smart process, with the fields chosen by the customer.

TRANSFER_TO_HUMAN.label: Transfer to an agent
TRANSFER_TO_HUMAN.description: After the agent replies, the conversation goes to a team member.
